summary: REFRESH (prior report Aug 10, 2026). The Aug 25 PDUFA delivered: zanidatamab is FDA-approved in 1L HER2+ GEA. Since then ZYME closed the Theravance acquisition and licensed ZW209 to Roche. Q3 on Nov 9 is the next dated catalyst. Consensus $41.36 (+46.5%; clears the gate), but FY26 revenue guidance ($278-292M) sits below the ~$304M Street figure. Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +15% assumes a ~1-3 month horizon for early GEA royalties to support the stock. The print is 14 days out. แนะนำ 3-5% ของ portfolio.

macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Held up: ZYME is +15% since the Aug 10 report and near the top of its 52-week range after the approval and Roche deal.

postWin.note: Approval on an already-partnered, already-marketed drug tends toward the muted end of the typical 30-200% first-approval range, since much is already priced in. ZYME's own 2024 BTC approval barely moved the stock (-8% same-day, alongside an earnings release); Omeros' first-in-class approval in Aug 2026 added only +8% premarket.

postLose.note: No direct ZYME-specific CRL precedent exists to cite — this is the general pattern for Priority-Review oncology sBLAs with strong Phase 3 data that still receive a CRL or restrictive label; the surprise factor amplifies the reaction versus a name where rejection was already expected.
postLose.exampleDate: N/A — general oncology PDUFA/CRL pattern, no ZYME-specific prior case

comparableCases.event: Ziihera (zanidatamab) accelerated approval — 2L HER2+ biliary tract cancer
comparableCases.note: Same drug's first FDA approval — the stock fell ~8% the day it was announced (alongside Q4 results) because accelerated approval was already largely expected. Direct precedent for why the Aug 25 GEA sBLA approval may not produce a large pop even if it clears.

comparableCases.event: Yartemlea first-in-class FDA approval (rare transplant complication)
comparableCases.note: Recent same-window example: even a genuine first-of-its-kind approval only produced a modest +8% premarket pop — approvals well-telegraphed by Priority Review status tend to already be partly priced in before the decision date.
